calibration_protocol: Raw vs sigmoid; inner stratified 3-fold OOF calibration on fit rows only. ensemble=False refits estimator on all fit rows. Isotonic excluded a priori because modest positive counts favor a lower-variance sigmoid.

selection.rationale: Require AP gain >= 0.02 AND lift gain >= 0.15 AND Brier increase <= 0.005; otherwise retain Logistic Regression. Calibration requires Brier reduction >= 0.002 AND log-loss reduction >= 0.005 with AP loss <= 0.01 and lift loss <= 0.10. All comparisons use the same training-only validation cohort.
